footnote_text: Represents restricted stock units ("RSUs") granted to the Reporting Person pursuant to the Issuer's 2026 Equity Incentive Plan (the "2026 Plan"). Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of the Issuer's common stock on the vesting date of the RSUs. 25% of the RSUs vest on the last day of the calendar quarter in which the first anniversary of the Vesting Commencement Date of July 8, 2026 occurs and an additional 6.25% of the RSUs vest at the end of each subsequent calendar quarter thereafter, subject to the Reporting Person's Continued Service (as defined in the 2026 Plan) with the Issuer as of each such vesting date.
Shares are compensation for director fees in lieu of cash and are fully vested. The Reporting Person has dividend and voting rights on all these shares.
